newTerms.God of Heaven / Spirit of Heaven: Dios del Cielo / Espíritu del Cielo

forcedChoices.reason: Spanish 'propaganda' reads as political or commercial advertising; the English means the spread of a teaching. Same at 94:9.1.
Spanish needs a neuter pronoun to keep the impersonal sense; 'ello' is neuter and matches 'ELLO ES' (94:3.3, 94:4.3).
Kept in capitals as in English; neuter 'ello' keeps the impersonal sense.
'the indwelling of the Brahman' means the Brahman that dwells within; 'morada interior del Brahman' could read as the Brahman's own dwelling place.

forcedChoices.choice: que el yo-alma se funde con la Superalma
forcedChoices.reason: Verb form instead of the noun 'fusión', so the merging does not read as the term 'Adjuster fusion'.
'destino' is the glossary form for 'destiny', a different idea in the papers.

forcedChoices.choice: Tanto Siva como Visnú son considerados por algunos como supremos
forcedChoices.reason: Keeps open which group holds which god supreme, as the English does.
'semidioses' is already used for 'demigods' in the same sentence.

forcedChoices.choice: las realidades en acto for 'the actuals'
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish 'los actuales' is a false friend ('current'); glossary form for 'actual' is 'en acto', which needs a noun.
Dying words to his followers; plural address uses 'ustedes'.
English 'right' governs all eight items; Spanish adjective agreement forces a repeat.
Commandment to the individual believer; the singular future is the natural form for a commandment. Same for 94:8.11-94:8.14.
Spanish 'protestante' reads as a Protestant Christian; the English means one who protests.
